review.reason: The frozen acceptance genuinely exercises the declared contract rather than scanning source strings or pinning exact answers. It compiles the actual candidate apps/web/frontend/lib/attention-key.ts with the project tsc and executes the emitted JS against an independent Python base64 oracle (test_10), and it runs tsc --noEmit on a temp copy importing the real @/lib/attention-record and @/lib/attention-key with @ts-expect-error markers that, when removed, must fail compilation with a real TS diagnostic (TS2339/TS2322), not a missing-tool error (test_20). The Lab fixture copies the real frontend (apps/web/frontend), symlinks node_modules, and boots next dev with a test-only route that calls the real getAttentionRecord over the real backendRequest/backend.ts transport, with a stateful ThreadingHTTPServer producer that logs method, raw once-encoded path, and cookie; dynamic mutation of producer state must change observed output, so canned rows cannot pass (test_30). Status handling is verified through the real Next redirect (303/307/308 + Location /login), not a JSON representation, and 403/404/503/Retry-After/500/connection-failure are classified with SECRET/item_id leak checks (test_40). Malformed-success fail-closed cases cover wrong ID, extra envelope/row keys, wrong generated scalar type, non-object rows and malformed JSON (test_50). A meta-test (test_60) proves the exact_hit/equality/redirect/no-fetch assertions actually fail when given wrong data, closing the vacuous-pass hole. test_70 boots the real b2 API under uvicorn with ReportingService in PUBLISHED mode over a DuckDB publication store, establishes a real signed local session, and compares candidate-parsed record rows against independently listed publication facts (list endpoint vs record endpoint) including slash IDs, multirow and NULLed market_reference. I verified the referenced helpers exist at b2 (backend.ts 1517 lines with backendRequest at 335-346, createBackendFetch 249-270 with cache no-store/redirect manual, buildOperationPath 307-320 encodeURIComponent; tests/test_attention_record_api.py DuckPublicationStore/seed/refresh/publish/attention_by_type/expected_records; tests/test_api_auth.py _build_client; ReportingService.get_attention_record + PUBLISHED path; generated TransactionAnomaliesRow/UpcomingFixedCostsRow/ContractReviewCandidatesRow/ContractRenewalWatchlistRow with the exact field sets the fixtures assume). No setup/collection masking, no skips, strict 8-name JUnit validation, bounded owned Docker fallback with ownership-verified cleanup. Minor non-blocking observations: backend.ts-unchanged is a scope/CI gate not directly asserted by the test, and ensure_tools pins v20.x (tighter than '20+'), neither of which permits a wrong implementation to pass.
review.trivial_pass: Strongest concrete attack: ship a getAttentionRecord that returns a fabricated/primed envelope (e.g. echoes the requested route key into a synthetic item_id, or returns a canned rows array) and a codec that silently replaces bytes or uses padded/noncanonical base64url, without reading the backend. This is rejected: test_30 mutates the producer's served records mid-test and asserts the observed rows change to match the new bytes, and its exact_hit oracle requires exactly one GET to the once-encoded literal /reports/<segment>/records/<id> path with the forwarded cookie, so a canned or list-fallback response cannot satisfy it; test_50 explicitly feeds a wrong-id envelope and asserts it fails closed (500 thrown, no ID substitution) rather than silently succeeding empty or substituted; test_70 cross-checks candidate-parsed rows against the independently listed publication rows under real signed auth, so fabricated facts or coercion cannot match; and test_10 requires exact equality with Python's base64.urlsafe_b64encode oracle plus TypeError on empty/non-string/unpaired surrogate, rejecting lossy or noncanonical encoding. The no-fetch control is also non-vacuous: test_00 fault-injects a direct producer hit to prove the hits logger is live before test_30 asserts zero hits for invalid kind/key.
checks: Actual candidate codec is compiled from apps/web/frontend/lib/attention-key.ts with the project tsc and executed under Node, and its encode output is compared byte-for-byte against an independent Python base64.urlsafe_b64encode oracle, not a copied answer.

Codec decode rejects the full invalid set (padding, noncanonical tail bits via 'YR', impossible length 'a', bad alphabet 'bad+', invalid UTF-8 '_w'/'wK8'/'7aCA', empty, non-string) and encode throws TypeError for empty/non-string/unpaired surrogate; browser build is exercised via Playwright 1.59.1 against the same source and cross-compared to the Node result.

Test-only Next app copies the real frontend source and imports the real getAttentionRecord from @/lib/attention-record over the real backend.ts backendRequest; the preflight hits /reports/attention-items through backendRequest to prove transport is live.

Producer is a stateful ThreadingHTTPServer logging method, raw path, cookie and every hit; dynamic mutation of served records must change the observed result (test_30), defeating canned/primed responses.

exact_hit oracle asserts exactly one GET to the once-encoded literal path (slash -> %2F, percent -> %25, Unicode intact) with cookie forwarded; test_60 falsifiers reject a second request, wrong segment, double-encoded %252F, truncated path, and missing cookie.

Static tsc --noEmit compiles a probe importing @/lib/attention-record and @/lib/attention-key; literal-kind narrowing, distributive/mapped union default, and switch(kind) narrowing are checked, and @ts-expect-error markers (anomaly has no market_reference; anomaly rows are not review rows) each fail with a real TS error code when removed, not a missing-tool error.

401 is verified as a real Next redirect (303/307/308 with Location /login) surfacing through isRedirectError, not a JSON representation; 403->denied, 404->not_found, 503->unavailable are classified before reading error bodies.

Retry-After is asserted only for valid nonnegative integer delta ('12') and valid HTTP-date, with 'not-a-date', '-1' and None forced to null; 500 and connection failure both throw sanitized errors with SECRET and item_id absent from the response.

Malformed-success fail-closed covers malformed JSON, scalar/null/array envelope, missing/extra envelope keys, mismatched item_id, non-array rows, non-object/array/string rows, unexpected row field, and wrong scalar for amount/expected_amount/score/days_until_renewal; none leak facts or fall back to empty/ID substitution.
Valid empty rows, null/missing known fields, and decimal strings (e.g. -12.3456, 9.8765) are passed through exactly, preserving order, duplicate multiplicity and precision without coercion.

test_70 runs the real b2 API under uvicorn with ReportingService(access_mode=PUBLISHED) over DuckPublicationStore, establishes a signed local session via /auth/login, and compares candidate-parsed record rows against independently listed publication facts (list vs record endpoints), including slash IDs, multirow groups and a NULLed market_reference.

Referenced fixtures/helpers verified present at b2: tests/test_attention_record_api.py (DuckPublicationStore/seed/refresh/publish/attention_by_type/expected_records), tests/test_api_auth.py _build_client, ReportingService.get_attention_record, DuckDBStore.memory, generated four row schemas with the exact field sets used.

No collection-time Docker/network/credential/tool checks (all such checks live inside tests and hard-fail rather than skip); main() enforces strict 8-named JUnit with skipped=0, failures=0, errors=0 and no skip/failure/error elements.

Browser run prefers provided WS or native Chromium; the owned Docker fallback is bounded to a pinned sha256 image with a unique owner label, cidfile, and ownership-verified docker rm cleanup, and Lab/stop() verify SIGTERM/SIGKILL process-group cleanup rather than asserting cleanup without checking.

Invalid kind/key returns invalid with zero producer hits (test_30), and the zero-fetch control is proven non-vacuous by test_00 fault-injecting a direct hit that must make the empty-hits assertion fail.
